results.evidence: The Koala Krack route page describes it as a short pitch reaching the otherwise non-obvious bolted rappel station on the ridge edge; the North Face page says the descent is three single-rope raps (60 m) from chains atop the North Face and at the P1 belay; a 2022 trip report found the first bolted anchors on the western side after a tricky scramble, used a 60 m rope, and notes other parties make more rappels below. So "1 rappel" undercounts; the descent from this station is the multi-rappel North Face line.
